newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates slip at end on liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates slip at end on liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates slipped on Saturday amid volatile trading on excess funds and are likely to remain low in next trading week beginning on Monday, dealers said.

"The rates maintained their volatility from the start of the trading hour," a dealer said. "Early deals were struck around 15 percent, which later slipped to 12.5 percent. The lenders, however, managed to push the rates back to 17 percent. But the rates tumbled again and finished at 10 percent on excess funds."
Dealers said one-week borrowers could not cover their positions around 12.50 percent as offers remained 15 percent.
